title: fix(week-08): final_m1 shadow runs only inside a finite window written before it (start <= now < end, at most 12 h, mtime <= start), read again at each turn it would note; buyer_switch_write writes the final_m1, moss_first and our_ask windows within each study's bounds, before the start, never over a running window, read back by the study's own reader (ax-pro-cycle step 5, main instruction 10); still default OFF [W-20261109-2225-AXPro주기]

fix(week-08): buyer_switch_write judges a running window by the real clock and takes no --now, keeps the window off stopped so the same study follows only after its end (--new-study otherwise), checks again just before the rename, keeps the switch's mode (independent review 7b17f3f I, M1-M3, N1-N2); still default OFF [W-20261109-2225-AXPro주기]

fix(week-08): buyer_switch_write keeps every window and off in an append-only history and judges what ran from it: an A/B study never reuses the salt of a window that ran and starts a new salt before the old end only with --new-study, the M1 shadow starts again only after the end and with --new-study; history unreadable or unwritable refuses (independent review 77cdbef I1, M1, M2, N1); still default OFF [W-20261109-2225-AXPro주기]

fix(week-08): buyer_switch_write keeps the window each write replaces and each off stops in its history, so a hand-written window is never forgotten; the switch's stopped record stands in for lost history and a switch with neither refuses; a window starting within 10 s counts as running; a put-back that fails removes the switch (off) and the command exits 2 (independent review 523fd38 M1, M2, N1-N3); still default OFF [W-20261109-2225-AXPro주기]

fix(week-08): buyer_switch_write counts every time a window was on as its own run, never merged by window, so the same window written twice still ran; a write keeps the stopped record it overwrites and a second off keeps the first's; an unknown past needs --new-study; a salt that is not a string is no salt; the put-back message says what happened (independent review 4eaf0b6 I1, M1, N1-N3); still default OFF [W-20261109-2225-AXPro주기]

fix(week-08): buyer_switch_write writers take turns on a lock (off waits, then stops anyway), a clock behind the history refuses, the running check is made again just before the rename, and an off that cannot read the history keeps the past unknown (adversarial review e0a5379 F1-F4); still default OFF [W-20261109-2225-AXPro주기]

fix(week-08): buyer_switch_write never makes a market dir that is not there, an off that wrote without the lock waits for it and looks again or exits 3 telling to run it again, the lock never leaks an fd and needs no write permission, blank history lines are skipped; clock and future-at limits written down (independent review 4948771 I1, M1-M3, N1-N3); still default OFF [W-20261109-2225-AXPro주기]
